model.tooltip: RIFE models for video frame interpolation. rife49 (v4.7) is the stable default. rife417 (v4.17) and rife426 (v4.26) are newer with improved quality. sudo_rife4 is a community-trained v4.0 variant.

precision.tooltip: Precision to build the tensorrt engines. Loaded from config.

resolution_profile.tooltip: Resolution range for TensorRT engine. Small: 384-1080px, Medium: 672-1312px, Large: 720-1920px. Smaller ranges use less VRAM.
